contributions.statement: Ship shared helper code inside skills (e.g. common parsing/extraction routines) when a task has many interdependent parts: without such skills Eval@1 fell from 55% to 30% as metric count rose from 1 to 5, while the skill-equipped pipeline held 60-65%.
contributions.evidence: §4.2 Finding 4, Table 9: Sonnet 4.5, n=20 agents (5 pp per agent), single runs, authors own system, benchmark and rubric.

contributions.statement: Give agents live retrieval of current library docs when target APIs move faster than model training: removing Context7 dropped Sonnet's executable-eval rate from 65% to 20% because of stale model identifiers and class patterns.
relative_to: retrieve current library documentation for fast-moving APIs (doc-RAG)

contributions.statement: A bare plan-then-implement stage without domain templates did not improve output and produced broader exception handling that hid failures as all-zero metrics.
contributions.evidence: §4.2 Finding 3, Table 8: B3 vs B4, LLM meta-evaluator win-tie rates, n=20.

reason: The ablations point somewhere useful, but at n=20 with a self-built benchmark, rubric and judge none clear moderate except the docs-retrieval result, which is known practice. Kept as hypotheses only.
